description: A shell script for testing various git diff and diff-tree commands, including setup, checking differences, conflict markers, and submodule differences.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a specific description.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command must fail.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
